create_Coordinator: create a Coordinator instance to manage thread stop signals via a threading event
use_request_stop: request the Coordinator to stop all coordinated threads by setting its internal event
use_stop_on_execution: use the stop_on_execution context manager to halt and exit on any unhandled exception
use_coordinated_get: use coordinated_get to safely retrieve items from a queue while respecting the Coordinator stop signal
use_coordinated_put: use coordinated_put to safely add items to a queue while respecting the Coordinator stop signal
